verdict.rationale: Helicone's core integration is code-based (one-line SDK swap, REST API, self-hosted via Docker Compose) with no UI dependency, meaning logging/gateway calls can run headlessly inside any automated pipeline, and webhooks/alerts support automation workflows. However, there is no explicit CI-specific documentation, headless-mode flag, or CI example configuration in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guide or example, documented non-interactive auth/setup flow for automated pipelines, and independent confirmation of headless CI usage.
